latin.457: §. X. Quicquid interim de Pontificiæ Transsubstantiationis Forma, sive quatuor, sive quinque verborum pronuntiationi, temerè satis & citra omnem Scripturæ S. authoritatem, affixa, fiat; Ipsa certè Transsubstantiatio, præsertim in omni suo ambitu concepta acceptaque, Sacro à Christo instituto Epulo prorsus indigna, dignissima verò est, quæ Ecclesiâ Christi totâ eliminetur.
latin.458: Transformatura alioquin hanc, (maximè omnium Necessitatem sui pluribus Anathematibus stabiliens) in verè Antichristianam, tam Revelationi divinæ de credendis pariter atque faciendis, quam Rationi humanæ, quin Sensibus omnibus, tyrannice insultans eorumque Vim infringere, atque abolere conata.
latin.459: Enimvero Transsubstantiatio adversatur (1) Scripturæ S. cujus autoritas hoc commentum tùm alibi evertit, tùm eô maximè loco, ubi Sacramenti hujus Institutio traditur, id quod ex Antithesi, duodenaria numerosiori, manifestissimè emergere facit insigne Ecclesiæ Reformatæ lumen B. Hottingerus Eucharistiæ defens. Sect. VIII. à p. m. 79. ad 84.
latin.460: Reverendiss. Guil. Forbesius præter multos ex Doctissimis Protestantibus, qui dogma Transsubstantiationis Scripturis adversari luculentissimè demonstrarunt, obsecrat quoque lectorem, adire, ex pontificiis ipsis, eruditam Picherelli Expositionem verborum Institutionis Coenæ Domini & ejusdem Dissertat. de Missa legere diligentissimeque considerare, necnon Archi-Ep. Spalatinum l. 5. de Republ. Eccles. cap. 6., fusissime hoc dogma impugnantem & refellentem Edit. Fabrician. noviss. p. 600. in media.
latin.461: (2.) Analogiæ fidei Divinæ, quà multos symboli Apostolici Articulos, plurimasque de Corporis Christi natura, nostris corporibus per omnia substantialia simili, Scripturæ assertiones. Contradictio hæc, Analogiæ Fidei intentata, usque adeò non tollitur per conficta hoc locô miracula, ut augeatur magis, quippe fidei quoque Analogiam, de Miraculorum natura ac scopo, infestans atque lacertans.
latin.462: Cum enim miracula rarò admodum, non temerè nec alio fine, à Deo patrari credenda Christianis sint, quam ut per ea, ceu omnem creatam finitamque potentiam supergressa opera, sensibus humanis clarissimè exposita, de veritate ejus, quod creditu difficile, planè convincantur; Hic quidem, seu in Missa papistica, è contrario quotidie innumeris vicibus, in innumeris locis, eadem repeti atque recurrere miracula, contra luculentissima sensuum humanorum de contrario plenissimè convictorum testimonia, credenda imperantur. Confer. Tillots. Volum. 3. Concionum p. m. 364. & 365. Ut hoc nomine perquam ingeniose B. Joh. Melchioris, non ita pridem Doctor Theologus Herbornensis, Transsubstantiationem, non nisi per Enthusiasmum, credibilem demonstraverit, Operum Theol. part. 2. à p. m. 467. ad 840.

pass_a.457: §. X. Whatever meanwhile be made of the Form of pontifical Transsubstantiation, affixed rashly enough and without all authority of Holy Scripture to the pronunciation of either four or five words; Transsubstantiation itself, especially conceived and taken in its whole ambit, is utterly unworthy of the Sacred Banquet instituted by Christ, and most worthy indeed to be eliminated from the whole Church of Christ.
pass_a.458: Otherwise about to transform this Church (establishing especially the Necessity of itself by many Anathemas) into a truly Antichristian one, tyrannically insulting both divine Revelation concerning things to be believed and done alike, and human Reason, nay all the Senses, and trying to break and abolish their force.
pass_a.459: For Transsubstantiation is adverse (1) to Holy Scripture, whose authority overthrows this fiction both elsewhere and most of all in that place where the Institution of this Sacrament is handed down — which Blessed Hottinger, distinguished light of the Reformed Church, makes emerge most manifestly from an antithesis more numerous than a dozen, Defense of the Eucharist Sect. VIII from p. 79 to 84.
pass_a.460: Most Reverend William Forbes, besides many of the most learned Protestants who have most lucidly shown the dogma of Transsubstantiation adverse to the Scriptures, also begs the reader to go and from the Pontificians themselves read and most diligently consider Picherellus’s learned Exposition of the Institution-words of the Lord’s Supper and the same man’s Dissertation on the Mass, and also Archbishop Spalatinus book 5 De Republica Ecclesiastica chapter 6, most fully attacking and refuting this dogma, newest Fabricius edition p. 600 in the middle.
pass_a.461: (2.) To the divine Analogy of faith, by which many Articles of the Apostles’ Creed, and very many Scriptural assertions concerning the nature of Christ’s Body, substantially like our bodies in all things. This Contradiction aimed at the Analogy of Faith is so far from being removed by miracles forged in this place that it is rather increased, inasmuch as it also infestively tears the Analogy of faith concerning the nature and scope of Miracles.
pass_a.462: For since Christians are to believe miracles are wrought by God only rarely, not rashly nor for another end than that through them, as works surpassing every created finite power, most clearly exposed to human senses, they may be plainly convinced of the truth of what is hard to believe; Here indeed, or in the papistic Mass, on the contrary daily in countless times and places the same miracles are commanded to be believed repeated and recurring, against the most lucid testimonies of human senses fully convinced of the contrary. Compare Tillotson, Volume 3 of Sermons pp. 364–365. So that under this name Blessed John Melchior, not long since Doctor of Theology at Herborn, most ingeniously demonstrated Transsubstantiation credible only through Enthusiasm, Opera Theologica part 2 from p. 467 to 840.

457: §.X: leave the four- or five-word Form fight — rashly pinned on without Scripture’s authority.
Transsubstantiation itself, taken in full scope, is utterly unworthy of Christ’s instituted banquet and most worthy to be wiped from Christ’s whole Church.
458: Otherwise it remakes the Church truly Antichristian — especially by staking its own Necessity on many Anathemas.
It tyrannizes divine Revelation (belief and practice), human Reason, and all the Senses, trying to break and abolish their force.
459: (1) It is adverse to Holy Scripture — overthrown elsewhere and above all where the Sacrament’s Institution is given.
Hottinger (Eucharist Defense VIII, pp. 79–84) shows that from an antithesis denser than a dozen.
460: Forbes, with many learned Protestants, has shown the dogma adverse to Scripture.
He also begs readers to weigh Pontificians against themselves: Picherellus on the Institution-words and the Mass, and Spalatinus De Republ. Eccles. 5.6 (Fabricius p. 600) refuting it at length.
461: (2) It clashes with the divine Analogy of faith — Creed articles and Scripture on Christ’s body as substantially like ours.
Forged miracles here do not heal that contradiction; they worsen it, tearing also the analogy of faith about what miracles are for.
462: Miracles should be rare, not rash, to convince the senses of what is hard to believe; the papistic Mass instead commands the same ‘miracle’ daily in countless places against the senses’ clearest contrary witness (Tillotson Sermons 3, pp. 364–365).
Melchior of Herborn ingeniously showed Transsubstantiation credible only by Enthusiasm (Opera Theol. 2, pp. 467–840).
Stop before (3) Praxis Christiana (first table / latria; cup withheld).
